# apple_pass_type_id (Data Source)

Looks up a pass type ID by its App Store Connect ID or identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_pass_type_id" "loyalty" {
  identifier = "pass.com.example.loyalty"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the pass type ID. Set this or `identifier`.
- `identifier` (String) Identifier, e.g. `pass.com.example`. Set this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Description of the pass type ID.
